rules.title: Jersey City ban on algorithmic rent coordination services
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic rent coordination services. The ban is enforced by both public and private action.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits a landlord’s use of algorithmic rent coordination services; includes public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.coverage_text: Landlords using algorithmic rent coordination services
rules.penalty: Fines up to $2,000 per day; public and private enforcement
rules.extraction_note: Secondary source (law firm LawFlash) summary table; the effective date is given only as June 2025; no enactment date or exemptions are stated.

rules.title: San Francisco ban on algorithmic devices using nonpublic competitor data
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use qualifying algorithmic devices that calculate nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy.
rules.key_value: Up to $1,000 per violation; each unit and month may be a separate violation
rules.quoted_span: The ordinance prohibits landlords from using qualifying algorithmic devices that calculate nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy.
rules.penalty: Tenant damages, injunctive relief and civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation; each month of use for each affected unit may be a separate violation
rules.extraction_note: Secondary source. The effective date is given only as October 2024.

rules.title: San Diego algorithmic rent-setting prohibition
rules.requirement: San Diego prohibits algorithmic rent-setting similar to San Francisco's ordinance. Tenants may sue for damages, injunctive relief and penalties.
rules.quoted_span: San Diego similarly authorizes tenant suits for damages, injunctive relief and penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and affected rental property potentially constituting a separate violation.
rules.penalty: Damages, injunctive relief, penalties up to $1,000 per violation; each month and affected property may be a separate violation
rules.extraction_note: Secondary source. The effective date is given only as June 2025.

rules.title: Seattle prohibition on algorithmic coordinating services
rules.requirement: Seattle prohibits landlords from using specified algorithmic coordinating services.
rules.quoted_span: Seattle’s ordinance expressly prohibits specified algorithmic coordinating services and provides penalties of up to $7,500 per violation.
rules.extraction_note: Secondary source. The effective date is given only as July 2025.

rules.title: Philadelphia algorithmic rent-setting ordinance
rules.requirement: Philadelphia prohibits use of algorithmic rent-pricing services such as RealPage. Aggrieved persons may recover statutory or treble damages.
rules.key_value: $2,000 per violation or treble actual damages
rules.quoted_span: Philadelphia’s ordinance permits an aggrieved person to elect statutory damages of $2,000 per violation or treble actual damages, together with equitable relief, interest and attorney fees and costs.
rules.penalty: Statutory damages of $2,000 per violation or treble actual damages, plus equitable relief, interest, attorney fees and costs
rules.extraction_note: Secondary source. The prohibited conduct is described only indirectly. The effective date is given only as February 2025.

rules.title: Providence ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices
rules.requirement: Providence prohibits the use of rent-setting algorithms. The city solicitor may bring enforcement actions.
rules.key_value: Civil penalties up to $500 per day per violation
rules.citation: Providence Code of Ordinances ch. 13, art. X, §§ 13-69–13-73
rules.quoted_span: The ordinance authorizes the city solicitor to bring enforcement actions and provides for civil penalties of up to $500 per day per violation, as well as costs and attorney fees in a successful enforcement action.
rules.penalty: Civil penalties up to $500 per day per violation, plus costs and attorney fees
rules.extraction_note: Secondary source. The effective date is given only as May 2025.

rules.title: Berkeley ban on coordinated pricing algorithms
rules.requirement: Berkeley prohibits coordinated pricing algorithms. Violations recur per unit and per month, with private remedies.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits coordinated pricing algorithms; recurring unit/month violations and private remedies, previously at issue in RealPage, Inc. v. City of Berkeley et al., (N.D. Cal.) (voluntarily dismissed with prejudice Jan. 14, 2026).
rules.extraction_note: Secondary source. RealPage's challenge to the ordinance was voluntarily dismissed with prejudice, so the ordinance is treated as in force. The effective date is given only as January 2026.

rules.title: Santa Ana ban on automated rent price-fixing
rules.requirement: Santa Ana prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing. Tenants may bring private claims.
rules.key_value: Up to $1,000 per violation and per month
rules.quoted_span: Ordinance NS-3090 prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing; private tenant claims and up to $1,000 per violation and per month.
rules.penalty: Private tenant claims; up to $1,000 per violation and per month

rules.title: Minneapolis ban on algorithmic devices using nonpublic competitor data
rules.requirement: Minneapolis prohibits algorithmic devices that use nonpublic competitor data to advise on vacancy or rental rates. Tenants may pursue civil actions.
rules.quoted_span: Effective March 1, 2026. Prohibits algorithmic devices using nonpublic competitor data to advise on vacancy or rental rates; tenants may pursue civil actions.

rules.title: Hoboken ban on algorithmic rent coordination
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits landlords from using software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.extraction_note: Secondary source. The effective date is given only as July 2025; no penalty is stated.

rules.title: King County algorithmic rent-setting ordinance remedies
rules.requirement: King County regulates algorithmic rent-setting. Injured renters may seek damages, statutory penalties and attorney fees.
rules.quoted_span: Injured renters may seek actual damages, up to $7,500 per violation and attorney fees.
rules.penalty: Actual damages, up to $7,500 per violation, attorney fees
rules.extraction_note: Secondary source. This is a county ordinance; level is set to 'city' because the schema has no county option. The prohibited conduct is not described.

rules.title: Spokane ban on purchasing algorithmic coordinating services
rules.requirement: Landlords may not purchase algorithmic coordinating services. The city enforces the ban with civil penalties.
rules.key_value: Civil penalties up to $5,000 per violation
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits landlords from purchasing algorithmic coordinating services; city enforcement includes civil penalties of up to $5,000 per violation.
rules.penalty: Civil penalties up to $5,000 per violation
rules.extraction_note: Secondary source. The effective date is given only as January 2026.

rules.title: Portland ban on algorithm-assisted rental price coordination
rules.requirement: Portland prohibits algorithm-assisted rental price coordination. Private remedies apply for owners of 16 or more units.
rules.key_value: Greater of treble damages or $1,000 per violation
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits algorithm-assisted rental price coordination; for owners of 16 or more units, private remedies include the greater of treble damages or $1,000 per violation.
rules.penalty: For owners of 16 or more units: greater of treble damages or $1,000 per violation
rules.extraction_note: Secondary source. The 16-unit threshold applies to owner portfolio size for private remedies, not building size, so min_units is 0. The effective date is given only as February 2026.

rules.title: Rockville ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic devices and shared competitor information to set rent, fees, or other rental terms.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits landlords from using algorithmic devices and shared competitor information to set rent, fees, or other rental terms.
rules.extraction_note: Secondary source. No penalty is stated.
